title: Trump Arrives in China for a First-Ever Meeting With Xi and Putin
summary: President Trump landed in southern China on Wednesday, November 18. On Thursday, he was set to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen, China. The meeting would be the first ever formal meeting of the leaders of China, Russia, and the United States. There was no set list of topics, but the leaders were expected to talk about war and peace, Iran and Ukraine, trade, and nuclear weapons. In a rare show of respect, Xi met Trump at the airport himself. In his 14 years in power, China's leader had never met a foreign leader at the airport before. Trump said he wants to talk about cutting back nuclear weapons, a hard topic. China, the United States, Russia, France, and Britain are the countries with nuclear weapons. China's nuclear arsenal is the fastest growing in the world. The Pentagon says that by 2030, China will have more than 1,000 nuclear warheads. That is still much less than the arsenals of the United States and Russia. Xi has long said he will not talk about arms control until China catches up with the other powers.
why_it_matters: When the leaders of big countries talk about war and peace, their choices can affect how safe the world is for everyone, including kids.

background_read: The leaders of big countries sometimes meet in person to talk about hard problems, like war and peace and trade, because talking face to face can help them understand each other.
Nuclear weapons are very powerful weapons, and arms control means countries agreeing to limit or cut back how many of them they have.
China, the United States, and Russia are three of the countries that have nuclear weapons, so a meeting of all three leaders together is a rare event.
